intro: Explore Lloret de Mar on the Costa Brava: sandy beaches, scenic coves, coastal paths, gardens, family activities and day trips to Tossa de Mar, Girona and Barcelona. Save your holiday plans, favourite visits and photos on this device.

areas.name: Lloret Town Centre
areas.description: Explore shopping streets, cafés and the parish church near the seafront.

areas.name: Lloret Beach
areas.description: Main resort beachfront with promenade, restaurants and seasonal watersports.

areas.name: Fenals
areas.description: Quieter beach district west of the centre, close to gardens and coastal walks.

areas.name: Santa Cristina
areas.description: Scenic beach area with wooded slopes and nearby chapel.

areas.name: Cala Canyelles
areas.description: Sheltered cove east of town with marina facilities; check seasonal access.

areas.name: Tossa de Mar
areas.description: Nearby historic seaside town, ideal for a day trip.

attractions.name: Santa Clotilde Gardens
attractions.description: Clifftop landscaped gardens with sea views; check opening times and tickets.

attractions.name: Church of Sant Romà
attractions.description: Distinctive historic parish church in the town centre.

attractions.name: Castell d’en Plaja
attractions.description: Photogenic private landmark at the eastern end of Lloret Beach; admire from public paths.

attractions.name: Camí de Ronda
attractions.description: Coastal walking paths linking beaches and viewpoints; some sections have steps.

attractions.name: Maritime Museum (Can Garriga)
attractions.description: Local maritime history in a seafront heritage building; check visitor details.

attractions.name: Modernist Cemetery
attractions.description: Historic cemetery known for modernist funerary architecture.

transport.name: Girona–Costa Brava Airport
transport.description: Nearby airport; check seasonal flights and transfers.

transport.name: Barcelona–El Prat Airport
transport.description: Larger international airport; check onward bus and rail connections.

transport.name: Lloret bus station
transport.description: Local and regional buses; check current schedules and routes.

transport.name: Blanes railway station
transport.description: Rail access via Blanes, with onward connections to Lloret by bus.

transport.name: Local taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm fares for longer journeys.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Central areas are walkable; coastal paths and coves may involve steep steps.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check card and cash withdrawal charges.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK passport and entry requirements before departure.

useful.name: Languages
useful.description: Catalan and Spanish; English is often spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow flags and lifeguard advice, especially when sea conditions change.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is normally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Seasonal services
useful.description: Water parks, boat trips and some restaurants may have seasonal hours.

beaches.name: Platja de Lloret
beaches.description: Main long sandy beach, central and lively in peak season.

beaches.name: Platja de Fenals
beaches.description: Wide beach with a calmer setting and nearby facilities.

beaches.name: Platja de Santa Cristina
beaches.description: Sheltered sandy beach surrounded by wooded slopes.

beaches.name: Cala Boadella
beaches.description: Scenic smaller cove reached by paths; check accessibility.

beaches.name: Cala Canyelles
beaches.description: Pretty cove east of town, with seasonal services.

beaches.name: Sa Caleta
beaches.description: Small cove by the coastal path at the eastern end of Lloret Beach.

markets.name: Town centre shopping
markets.description: Explore shops and local businesses along the pedestrian streets.

markets.name: Municipal market
markets.description: Check the current opening hours for fresh food and local produce.

markets.name: Weekly street market
markets.description: Ask local tourist information for the current day and location.

markets.name: Supermarkets and essentials
markets.description: Find groceries and beach supplies in town; Sunday hours vary.

nightlife.name: Town centre nightlife
nightlife.description: Bars and late-night venues concentrated in central streets; check age rules and opening hours.

nightlife.name: Seafront terraces
nightlife.description: Enjoy cafés and evening drinks along the promenade.

nightlife.name: Live music and events
nightlife.description: Look for seasonal concerts and local cultural events.

nightlife.name: Fenals evenings
nightlife.description: Relaxed restaurants and bars near Fenals Beach.

family.name: Water World
family.description: Water park near Lloret; seasonal opening, ticket prices and height restrictions apply.

family.name: Fenals Beach
family.description: Family beach outing; always follow flags and lifeguard instructions.

family.name: Santa Clotilde Gardens
family.description: Walk through landscaped gardens with coastal views.

family.name: Maritime Museum
family.description: Learn about the town’s seafaring past.

family.name: Boat excursions
family.description: Check seasonal coastal cruises, weather and return times.

dining.name: Old Town restaurants
dining.description: Browse Catalan and Spanish restaurants around the centre.

dining.name: Seafront dining
dining.description: Beachfront cafés and restaurants with Mediterranean views.

dining.name: Seafood and rice dishes
dining.description: Look for local fish dishes and Catalan rice specialities.

dining.name: Fenals restaurants
dining.description: Dining options around the quieter Fenals district.

dining.name: Family-friendly meals
dining.description: Check menus, dietary requirements and seasonal opening hours.

daytrips.name: Tossa de Mar
daytrips.description: Explore the walled old town, beaches and coastal scenery; check transport connections.

daytrips.name: Blanes
daytrips.description: Visit beaches and botanical gardens in the neighbouring coastal town.

daytrips.name: Girona
daytrips.description: Explore medieval lanes, cathedral surroundings and historic city walls.

daytrips.name: Barcelona
daytrips.description: Plan a full-day city visit; check bus or rail connections and return times.

daytrips.name: Sant Feliu de Guíxols
daytrips.description: Coastal town with a promenade and maritime heritage.

daytrips.name: Marimurtra Botanical Garden
daytrips.description: Botanical garden in Blanes with sea views; check ticketing and access.
